title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
facts: Steven Spielberg directed the film. Lawrence Kasdan wrote the screenplay, from a story by George Lucas and Philip Kaufman.
Indiana Jones is named after George Lucas's dog, an Alaskan Malamute called Indiana.
Tom Selleck was offered the lead role, but he was committed to the TV series Magnum, P.I.
The film won four Academy Awards plus a Special Achievement Award for sound effects editing.
Raiders of the Lost Ark was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Picture.
It was the highest-grossing film of 1981.
John Williams composed the score, including "The Raiders March".
A long sword fight was planned for the Cairo market. Harrison Ford was ill, so Indy simply shoots the swordsman.
The desert scenes were filmed in Tunisia.
Karen Allen plays Marion Ravenwood. Paul Freeman plays Belloq. John Rhys-Davies plays Sallah.
Raiders of the Lost Ark opened in the United States on June 12, 1981.
In 1999 the Library of Congress selected the film for the National Film Registry.
Alfred Molina made his film debut as Satipo, Indy's guide in the opening scene.
The Well of Souls scene used thousands of real snakes.
The interior sets were built at Elstree Studios in England.
A carving of R2-D2 and C-3PO is hidden among the hieroglyphs in the Well of Souls.
